summary: HDFC Bank Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 14, 2026, submitting its Integrated Annual Report for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, as required under SEC rules. This is a routine regulatory filing by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. The filing simply discloses the annual report to the NYSE and SEC, containing no transaction terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. There is no deal, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or any other special-situation event described. The document is purely a periodic disclosure of financial and operational results.
